basic_details.job_title: Sainik School Nalanda Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 PGT, Mess Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: Sainik School Nalanda, a residential public school run under the Sainik Schools Society, Ministry of Defence, and affiliated to CBSE, New Delhi, has invited applications for two contractual posts: one PGT (Physics) and one Mess Manager, both for the UR category. Applications on the prescribed format must reach the Principal at Vill- Nanand, PO- Pawapuri, Dist- Nalanda, Bihar, Pin Code- 803115, on or before 7 November 2026. The notice does not print a time for the deadline.

application_fee.details: The fee is a non-refundable Demand Draft drawn in favour of the Principal, Sainik School Nalanda, payable at SBI, VIMS Pawapuri (Branch Code No 18429) or PNB, Pawapuri (Branch Code No 294200). The notice also says the fee may be deposited online through the link under the 'Online Fee' option on the school website.

qualification.details: Essential: Master's degree in Physics from a recognized university with at least 50% marks; B Ed Degree; CTET qualified. Desirable: preference will be given to candidates with higher qualifications, teaching/working experience in English medium Public Schools, especially Sainik Schools, proficiency in spoken English, ICT applications, and games as well as co-curricular activities. Age: 21 to 50 Years, counted on the last date of receipt of application. | Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; at least five years' experience of running a catering organization independently in the civil, in the Defence Services or in any other similar organization; ability to maintain mess accounts. Desirable: Diploma/Degree in catering from a recognized institution; JCO or equivalent from catering trade or with more than 5 years catering experience. Age: 18 to 50 Years, counted on the last date of receipt of application. | The notice does not list age relaxation for any category. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

selection_process: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a Written Test and a Skill Test. Only candidates who qualify in the Written Test will be eligible for the next test. The notice does not give the test dates
syllabus or marks. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the Written Test or any other test.
important_instructions: Both posts are contractual and are marked for the UR reservation category. The school administration reserves the right to reject incomplete applications or cancel the vacancies due to administrative or policy reasons. The school is not responsible for postal delay or loss of documents en route. Applications reaching the school after the due date will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: About Sainik School Nalanda
content_sections.text: Sainik School Nalanda is described in the notice as a residential public school run under the aegis of the Sainik Schools Society, Ministry of Defence, Government of India, and affiliated to CBSE, New Delhi. The school is at Vill- Nanand, PO- Pawapuri, Dist- Nalanda, Bihar. The notice is signed by the Principal and dated 4 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be sent to: The Principal, Sainik School Nalanda, Vill- Nanand, PO- Pawapuri, Dist- Nalanda, State- Bihar, Pin Code- 803115. The notice allows Ordinary, Registered or Speed Post, courier or delivery by hand. The application must reach the school on or before 7 November 2026. The school says it is not responsible for postal delay or loss of documents en route, and applications reaching after the due date will not be accepted. A scanned advance copy of the application and supporting documents may also be forwarded to [email protected] . The notice does not give a subject line for this email. The prescribed application format is available on the school website, www.sainikschoolnalanda.edu.in . A passport size photograph goes with it. For further details, call 06112-291507 or 8340218798 (0830h-1400h and 1700h-1900h) on all working days.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential: Master's degree in Physics from a recognized university with at least 50% marks; B Ed Degree; CTET qualified. Desirable: preference will be given to candidates with higher qualifications, teaching/working experience in English medium Public Schools, especially Sainik Schools, proficiency in spoken English, ICT applications, and games as well as co-curricular activities. Age: 21 to 50 Years, counted on the last date of receipt of application. Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; at least five years' experience of running a catering organization independently in the civil, in the Defence Services or in any other similar organization; ability to maintain mess accounts. Desirable: Diploma/Degree in catering from a recognized institution; JCO or equivalent from catering trade or with more than 5 years catering experience. Age: 18 to 50 Years, counted on the last date of receipt of application. The notice does not list age relaxation for any category. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is a non-refundable Demand Draft drawn in favour of the Principal, Sainik School Nalanda, payable at SBI, VIMS Pawapuri (Branch Code No 18429) or PNB, Pawapuri (Branch Code No 294200). The notice also says the fee may be deposited online through the link under the 'Online Fee' option on the school website.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice: Duly filled prescribed application form with a passport size photograph Self-attested copies of academic documents Experience certificate Caste certificate (if applicable) Unstamped self-addressed envelope (9'x4') Non-refundable Demand Draft of Rs 500/- (Unreserved and OBC) or Rs 300/- (SC and ST)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a Written Test and a Skill Test. Only candidates who qualify in the Written Test will be eligible for the next test. The notice does not give the test dates, syllabus or marks. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the Written Test or any other test.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Both posts are contractual and are marked for the UR reservation category. The school administration reserves the right to reject incomplete applications or cancel the vacancies due to administrative or policy reasons. The school is not responsible for postal delay or loss of documents en route. Applications reaching the school after the due date will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Sainik School Nalanda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 for PGT (Physics) and 1 for Mess Manager, both contractual and both in the UR category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the school on or before 7 November 2026. Late applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for PGT (Physics)?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Physics from a recognized university with at least 50% marks, a B Ed Degree and CTET qualification are essential.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Mess Manager?
faq.answer: Matriculation or equivalent, at least five years' experience of running a catering organization independently, and ability to maintain mess accounts are essential.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 50 Years for PGT (Physics) and 18 to 50 Years for Mess Manager, counted on the last date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay?
faq.answer: Consolidated pay is Rs 76,160 per month for PGT (Physics) and Rs 46,720 per month for Mess Manager.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs 500/- for Unreserved and OBC candidates and Rs 300/- for SC and ST candidates, paid by non-refundable Demand Draft. It may also be deposited online under the 'Online Fee' option on the school website.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application format from the school website and send it with the listed documents and Demand Draft to the Principal, Sainik School Nalanda, Pawapuri, by post, courier or by hand so that it reaches by 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Can I email my application instead of posting it?
faq.answer: A scanned advance copy of the application and documents may also be emailed to [email protected]. The notice still asks for the duly filled form with documents and Demand Draft to reach the Principal.

faq.question: Q10. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates are called for a Written Test and Skill Test, and only those who qualify in the Written Test are eligible for the next test. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the tests.
